header.summary: Every strategy fits its volume. AC Repair's target changed on Oct 16, so it waits until its re-check date. Furnace Repair is limited by budget, not by bidding, and Water Heaters and PMax have the volume for a CPA target. One lead action counts more than once per click.

areas.key_number: 1 counted lead action counts many per click
lowest volume: AC Installation | Search at 11.1 a month
1 on target, 1 not graded while settling
conversion value is 0 on every action

notes: absolute-top impression share 86% against a 90% goal: within 10 points, on target
39 conversions a month: enough for a CPA target near $60
30 conversions a month: enough for a CPA target near $56
58% of impression share lost to rank
max CPC limit $6.00 against a 30-day average CPC of $6.11: the limit holds it back
late share 27%: +7 days on any settling window
31 conversions a month: enough for a CPA target near $69

red_flags.flag: CPA up while impression share falls
red_flags.closest_case: no campaign's CPA worsened; the biggest rise is AC Repair | Search, flat (+7% vs prior 30 days)
AC Repair | Search: weekly CPA $73 to $85 (under 2x)

red_flags.flag: Missing its target while limited by budget
red_flags.closest_case: no Target CPA campaign is limited by budget; Furnace Repair is, but it has no target

strategy_switches: none in the 30-day history; for older switches, tell me the date

portfolios.pooling: no campaign warns or fails on data fit, so pooling wouldn't lift anything

next_steps: agree what a booked call and a booked form are worth
import booked jobs from your scheduling system as an offline conversion

recommendations.change: Leave AC Repair | Search alone until 2026-10-30
recommendations.why: its target changed on 2026-10-16; the bidder needs 14 days
recommendations.rollback: if CPA is over 1.3 x target on the re-check date, go back to the old target

recommendations.change: Give Water Heaters | Search a CPA target of $56
recommendations.why: Maximize conversions with no target at 30 conversions a month; a target near today's $56.13 gives the bidder a ceiling
recommendations.who: I can do this after you confirm
recommendations.success_check: 2026-10-21 to 2026-11-04: CPA within 10% of $56, conversions within 15% of today's pace
recommendations.rollback: if CPA is over $73 or conversions fall 25% by 2026-11-04, clear the target

recommendations.change: Leave Furnace Repair | Search's bidding alone; the budget is the limit
recommendations.why: LIMITED_BY_BUDGET, 39 conversions a month: enough for a CPA target near $60

recommendations.change: Agree a value for a booked call and a booked form with the user before any value bidding
recommendations.who: you, then I can set default values

recommendations.change: Remove the unused portfolio 'Old target CPA $45'
recommendations.who: I can do this after you confirm (permanent)

recommendations.change: Count 'Calls from website (60s+)' once per click
recommendations.why: it counts MANY_PER_CLICK, so one caller can count several times
recommendations.who: do this in Google Ads (Goals > Conversions); the action can't change counting type

what_not_to_do: Don't tighten Furnace Repair's bidding to cut cost: it is limited by budget, so a tighter target only shrinks volume.
Don't edit AC Repair again before its re-check date: every edit restarts learning.
